units.source_text: 古歌：“但愿清秋夜未央，千宵并作一宵长。

en.t: An old poem says: If only the clear autumn night would not yet end, and a thousand evenings could be joined into one long night.

units.source_text: 不曾说尽胸中事，窗外金鸡报晓忙。”

en.t: Before all the feelings in my heart have been spoken, the golden rooster outside the window hastens to announce the dawn.
This appears in The Tales of Ise.
